about.paragraph: I started out as a wildlife photographer. One afternoon I was shooting in the park when I noticed a dog show going on nearby, so I wandered over for a look and started taking pictures and the owners I met wanted proper portraits of their dogs. That was the start of Toma & Pals. I still work mostly outdoors, where dogs are at their most playful and themselves, and I bring my wildlife habits with me: patience, natural light, and waiting for the moment rather than forcing it.
